name: caderno-dividas
description: Caderno de Dívidas para controle de finanças pessoais

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "SHARED,API,WEB" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w @organizador/shared" "npm run dev -w @organizador/api" "npm run dev -w @organizador/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @organizador/shared && npm run build -w @organizador/api && node --test tests/financial-rules.test.cjs tests/purchase-simulation.test.cjs tests/shopping-list.test.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @organizador/shared && npm run build -w @organizador/api && npm run build -w @organizador/web && npm run build -w @organizador/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build && npm run start -w @organizador/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w @organizador/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @organizador/api && npm run build -w @organizador/api && npm run build:desktop -w @organizador/web && npm run build -w @organizador/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && node apps/desktop/scripts/stage.cjs && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.cjs --win nsis --x64
